verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device inference SDK and CLI, so CPU+GPU layer offloading is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence documents splitting a model between CPU and GPU memory to exceed VRAM. The only related item is hosted Wally Cloud execution for models too large for a laptop, which is a different capability (remote execution, not local offload) and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run models larger than my available VRAM using combined CPU+GPU offload
